task.description:

1. **fn:update-requirement-status**: Set DSL-04 status to RELEASED in docs/status/requirement_status.json. Set released_at, release_run, last_updated fields.

3. Write the inner report.
4. Check if this run has estimation.json and run the retrospective procedure if so.
